createRateCard.description: Create a new Rate Card with shared billing fields, dimension keys, and a list of items. Each item entry creates a Rate Card Item object.

currency.description: Currency of the items of this rate card (in 3-letter ISO-4217 format).

description.description: Rate card description. Used for internal classification and identification.

dimension_keys.description: Subset of or equal to the Meter's `dimension_keys`. Defines which dimension keys are used in each item's `dimension_values`.

items.description: Ordered list of item definitions. Each entry creates a Rate Card Item object. At least one is required.

additionalProperties.description: A dimension value that this item applies to.

dimension_values.description: The dimension values this item applies to. Each key must be one of the `dimension_keys` (a subset is allowed). Any key omitted here acts as a wildcard, matching any value for that dimension; an empty object matches all usage (a catch-all).

lot.description: Defines how quantity is grouped into billable lots. The `unit_amount` is then applied per lot. If not set, quantity is treated as the number of billable lots. Only applicable for `PER_UNIT`.

rounding_mode.description: Specifies how to round the calculated lots when the total quantity is not an exact multiple of the size. One of `UP`.

size.description: The amount of quantity that constitutes a single billable lot.

pricing_model.description:
Specify how to calculate the total billing amount when a quantity is provided. One of
- `PER_UNIT`: a fixed price per unit quantity.
- `VOLUME`: the unit price is based on which tier the total quantity falls in.
- `GRADUATED`: the unit price changes as the quantity increases.

tiers.description: List of quantity-based pricing tiers for this item. Required when the pricing model is `VOLUME` or `GRADUATED`.

flat_amount.description: The flat amount to be charged for this tier when pricing model is `GRADUATED`, or the overall flat amount to be charged when pricing model is `VOLUME`.

unit_amount.description: The per-unit amount to be charged for this tier when pricing model is `GRADUATED`, or the overall per-unit amount to be charged when pricing model is `VOLUME`.

unit_description.description: Description of the billable unit for the tier.

upper_bound.description: The upper quantity limit of this tier. For the last tier, the upper bound must be left empty.

unit_amount.description: The amount to be charged per product unit. Only required when the pricing model is `PER_UNIT`.

unit_description.description: Description of the billable unit for this item.

additionalProperties.description: A set of key-value pairs that you can attach to this object for storing additional information.

metadata.description: A set of key-value pairs that you can attach to this object for storing additional information.

meter_id.description: ID of the shared [Meter](/docs/api/billing/meters) object specifying how to calculate the usage for the items of this rate card.

product_id.description: ID of the [Product](/docs/api/billing/products) object this rate card is associated with.

recurring.description: The frequency at which the items of this rate card are charged.

period.description: The number of period units between subscription billing cycles. For example, the billing cycle is bi-monthly if `period=2` and `period_unit=MONTH`. Defaults to `1`.

period_unit.description: Specifies billing frequency. One of `DAY`, `WEEK`, `MONTH` or `YEAR`.

request_id.description: Unique request ID specified by the merchant.

tax_included.description: Whether the item prices include tax. Defaults to `false`.

createRateCardVersion.description: Publish a new Rate Card version. `items` is the complete ordered list; each entry is either the `id` of an existing Rate Card Item (carried forward by reference) or an inline definition of a new item.

dimension_keys.description: The dimension keys this version prices by — a subset of the Meter's `dimension_keys`. Append-only across versions — must be a superset of the previous version's. Inherits the previous version's set if omitted.

items.description: Ordered list of item definitions. Each entry is either an existing Rate Card Item (carried forward by specifying an `id`) or an inline definition of a new item, but not both. At least one is required.

additionalProperties.description: A dimension value that this item applies to.

dimension_values.description: The dimension values this item applies to. Each key must be one of the version's `dimension_keys` (a subset is allowed). Any key omitted here acts as a wildcard, matching any value for that dimension; an empty object matches all usage (a catch-all).

id.description: ID of an existing Rate Card Item from this Rate Card to carry forward into the new version.

lot.description: Defines how quantity is grouped into billable lots. The `unit_amount` is then applied per lot. If not set, quantity is treated as the number of billable lots. Only applicable for `PER_UNIT`.

rounding_mode.description: Specifies how to round the calculated lots when the total quantity is not an exact multiple of the size. One of `UP`.

size.description: The amount of quantity that constitutes a single billable lot.

pricing_model.description:
Specify how to calculate the total billing amount when a quantity is provided. One of
- `PER_UNIT`: a fixed price per unit quantity.
- `VOLUME`: the unit price is based on which tier the total quantity falls in.
- `GRADUATED`: the unit price changes as the quantity increases.

tiers.description: List of quantity-based pricing tiers for this item. Required when the pricing model is `VOLUME` or `GRADUATED`.

flat_amount.description: The flat amount to be charged for this tier when pricing model is `GRADUATED`, or the overall flat amount to be charged when pricing model is `VOLUME`.

unit_amount.description: The per-unit amount to be charged for this tier when pricing model is `GRADUATED`, or the overall per-unit amount to be charged when pricing model is `VOLUME`.

unit_description.description: Description of the billable unit for the tier.

upper_bound.description: The upper quantity limit of this tier. For the last tier, the upper bound must be left empty.

unit_amount.description: The amount to be charged per product unit. Only required when the pricing model is `PER_UNIT`.

unit_description.description: Description of the billable unit for this item.
